# Generated by eu5autobuild.generator.
# Generic actions used by the visible controls in the Advanced Auto Build window.

eu5ab_apply_preset_granary_to_selected_location = {
	type = owncountry
	player_automated_category = buildings
	show_in_gui_list = no
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = { always = yes }
	allow = { always = yes }
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				every_owned_location = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
					add_to_list = source
				}
			}
		}
		target_flag = target_location
		name = eu5ab_choose_location
		map_mode = raw_material
		bottom_widget = eu5ab_automation_policy_footer
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = { always = yes }
		enabled = { always = yes }
		tooltip_msg_key = eu5ab_location_select_tooltip
	}
	effect = {
		scope:target_location ?= {
			eu5ab_apply_policy_granary_to_location = yes
			remove_variable = eu5ab_template_slot
		}
		# Scope view is rebuilt on demand, never during map selection.
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}

eu5ab_apply_preset_granary_to_selected_province = {
	type = owncountry
	player_automated_category = buildings
	show_in_gui_list = no
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = { always = yes }
	allow = { always = yes }
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				every_owned_location = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
					province = {
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { is_in_list = source } }
							add_to_list = source
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		target_flag = target_province
		name = eu5ab_choose_province
		map_mode = raw_material
		bottom_widget = eu5ab_automation_policy_footer
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = { always = yes }
		enabled = { always = yes }
		tooltip_msg_key = eu5ab_province_select_tooltip
	}
	effect = {
		scope:target_province ?= {
			every_location_in_province = {
				limit = { owner ?= scope:actor NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
				eu5ab_apply_policy_granary_to_location = yes
				remove_variable = eu5ab_template_slot
			}
		}
		# Scope view is rebuilt on demand, never during map selection.

	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }

	potential = { always = yes }
	allow = { always = yes }
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = area
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				every_owned_location = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
					area = {
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { is_in_list = source } }
							add_to_list = source
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		target_flag = target_area
		name = eu5ab_choose_area
		map_mode = raw_material
		bottom_widget = eu5ab_automation_policy_footer
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = { always = yes }
		enabled = { always = yes }
		tooltip_msg_key = eu5ab_area_select_tooltip
	}
	effect = {
		scope:target_area ?= {
			every_location_in_area = {
				limit = { owner ?= scope:actor NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
				eu5ab_apply_policy_food_priority_to_location = yes
				remove_variable = eu5ab_template_slot
			}
		}
		# Scope view is rebuilt on demand, never during map selection.
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}

eu5ab_apply_template_slot_1_to_selected_location = {
	type = owncountry
	player_automated_category = buildings
	show_in_gui_list = no
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = { always = yes }
	allow = { always = yes }
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				every_owned_location = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
					add_to_list = source
				}
			}
		}
		target_flag = target_location
		name = eu5ab_choose_location
		map_mode = raw_material
		bottom_widget = eu5ab_automation_policy_footer
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = { always = yes }
		enabled = { always = yes }
		tooltip_msg_key = eu5ab_location_select_tooltip
	}
	effect = {
		scope:target_location ?= {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_policy_id value = 100 }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_template_slot value = 1 }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_policy_decoupled
			eu5ab_register_location_for_scan = yes
		}
		# Scope view is rebuilt on demand, never during map selection.
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}

		looking_for_a = province

			scope:actor = {
				every_owned_location = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
					province = {
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { is_in_list = source } }
							add_to_list = source
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		target_flag = target_province
		name = eu5ab_choose_province
		map_mode = raw_material
		bottom_widget = eu5ab_automation_policy_footer
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = { always = yes }
		enabled = { always = yes }
		tooltip_msg_key = eu5ab_province_select_tooltip
	}
	effect = {
		scope:target_province ?= {
			every_location_in_province = {
				limit = { owner ?= scope:actor NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_policy_id value = 100 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_template_slot value = 1 }
				remove_variable = eu5ab_policy_decoupled
				eu5ab_register_location_for_scan = yes
			}
		}
		# Scope view is rebuilt on demand, never during map selection.
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}

eu5ab_apply_template_slot_6_to_selected_area = {
	type = owncountry
	player_automated_category = buildings
	show_in_gui_list = no
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = { always = yes }
	allow = { always = yes }
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = area
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				every_owned_location = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
					area = {
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { is_in_list = source } }
							add_to_list = source
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		target_flag = target_area
		name = eu5ab_choose_area
		map_mode = raw_material
		bottom_widget = eu5ab_automation_policy_footer
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = { always = yes }
		enabled = { always = yes }
		tooltip_msg_key = eu5ab_area_select_tooltip
	}
	effect = {
		scope:target_area ?= {
			every_location_in_area = {
				limit = { owner ?= scope:actor NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_policy_id value = 100 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_template_slot value = 6 }
				remove_variable = eu5ab_policy_decoupled
				eu5ab_register_location_for_scan = yes
			}
		}
		# Scope view is rebuilt on demand, never during map selection.
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}

		}

	player_automated_category = buildings
	show_in_gui_list = no
	show_message = no

	automation_tick = never

eu5ab_apply_template_slot_17_to_selected_province = {
	type = owncountry
	player_automated_category = buildings
	show_in_gui_list = no
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = { always = yes }
	allow = { always = yes }
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				every_owned_location = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
					province = {
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { is_in_list = source } }
							add_to_list = source
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		target_flag = target_province
		name = eu5ab_choose_province
		map_mode = raw_material
		bottom_widget = eu5ab_automation_policy_footer
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = { always = yes }
		enabled = { always = yes }
		tooltip_msg_key = eu5ab_province_select_tooltip
	}
	effect = {
		scope:target_province ?= {
			every_location_in_province = {
				limit = { owner ?= scope:actor NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_policy_id value = 100 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_template_slot value = 17 }
				remove_variable = eu5ab_policy_decoupled
				eu5ab_register_location_for_scan = yes
			}
		}
		# Scope view is rebuilt on demand, never during map selection.
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}
